description: I am a 7th grade student believing and considering the risks of wildfires inside small and vulnerable regions. I consider important the use of technology inside vulnerable regions for surveilance while mantaining the security in areas where wildfires are not easily controled. I believe that people must understand the risks and take action on problems that perhaps are easily controled and contribute on projects similar to these. I consider myself as a self- learner and a skilled public speaker.
summary: We look forward to the protection over green areas using our special system based on records and information making it easier for students like us and other people to understand the risks over wildfires. We developed a system looking to solve the conflicts caused by wildfires while gathering information useful for us to see different heat sources/hot spots letting us understand the healing time a wildfires needs to recover. We used useful data to develop a system useful not only for our city, but Earth globally.
details: This web application is a project developed by students that consider wildfires a risk towards our society and other regions on earth. This project uses real time connection with satellites and information gathered by sattelites or other data sources. The project intends to impact societies and security towards green areas that have been seen affected by wildfires. We used vibecoding to make the proccess of deeloping the web much easier mantaining critical information adn data useful for the surveilance over hot spots. We used tools that helped gather information over all countries and areas that were once affected by wildfires. Our project is creative with th use of interactive maps and lists over all the wildfires recorded in our city. Our team considered the use of real world data looking for impact over our society and other regions suffering from wildfires. We also considered the use of SI for vibecoding and the development of our system using data and critical information during the proccess.
